title: About your personal loan application
intro: Aisha applied for AED 18,000 to pay a course fee. Shown the day the decision is made. Every detail is invented.

tiles.label: Our answer
tiles.sub: We can't offer this loan today. The main reason is below, in one line.

tiles.label: Main reason (H1)
tiles.sub: You have been with your employer for 11 months. For this loan we look for at least 12.

tiles.label: What would change it (H2)
tiles.sub: Nothing else in your application stood in the way.

tiles.label: If you think we got it wrong
tiles.sub: A person looks at your application again within five working days.
